detail.longDescription: KubeStellar Hive is an open-source project for orchestrating fleets of AI agents across GitHub repos - planning, coding, reviewing, testing, fixing issues & maintenance. Explore where multi-agent open-source development is headed. Part of KubeStellar, a CNCF Sandbox project.
